role: A-only teacher evidence; not artwork or renderer geometry
registration: crop (x,y) maps to image.jpg source (500+x,320+y), no resize/stretch

method.crop: copied registered crop; dimensions and SHA-256 checked against the task freeze
method.landmarks: manual semantic point observations from the displayed full registered crop, recorded as crop coordinates and mapped by fixed translation; all interpretations provisional for fresh review
method.overlay: Pillow 12.3.0 ImageDraw; Lanczos display-only enlargement 2x; finite point markers and dashed topology pointers keyed to landmarks.csv; script contains exact operation
method.segmentation_or_trace: none; no masks, frequency segmentation, boundary extraction, contour tracing, or renderer input

tolerance_note: Not applicable: no algorithmic segmentation, edge extraction, fitted contour, or raster-to-geometry materialization was performed. Point coordinates are manually read semantic anchors with per-point confidence/limits in landmarks.csv, not precision-fit boundaries.
coordinate_semantics: landmark points indicate local observed features, not exact subpixel boundary intersections; dashed links express only adjacency hypotheses, never contours/seams
isolation: teacher-only A evidence; prohibited as input to B, heldout, scene source, renderer, or reproduction
